title: Class relation linear algebra
objective: Implement sparse relation storage, modular rank/pivot screening, exact HNF/SNF presentation extraction and replay, with differential FLINT tests

handoff.summary: Added a standalone sparse relation accumulator with multi-prime incremental pivot screening, unlucky-prime replay, exact FLINT HNF/SNF extraction, ordinary-Python transform fallback, replayable class-map generator transforms, and left-kernel unit transforms. Frozen Sage 10.9 elementary-divisor fixtures and native-on/native-off differential, corruption, serialization, map, unit-kernel, collision, and benchmark tests pass.
risks: Rows are relation exponent vectors in factor-base order and act on the right: H = H_left*A and S = S_left*A*S_right. Consumers using column vectors must transpose explicitly.
Exact transforms are intentionally dense once extraction is requested; relation collection should retain the sparse accumulator and defer presentation extraction until modular full rank is reached.
The coordinator requested focused handoff validation; broad test:native and test:changed gates remain for central integration and four-platform CI.
next_steps: Wire RelationMatrixAccumulator.to_dict as the shared context matrix_state and RelationPresentation.generator_transforms/class_coordinates into the maps lane.
Run central broad native, changed-file, and four-platform validation after integrating sibling class/unit lanes.
